overview: Single independent Go service with no dependencies, so all work happens in one foundation phase.

phases.name: Foundation Service
phases.description: Implement the standalone Todo API service with embedded SQLite persistence.

components.name: todo-api
responsibilities: Expose REST endpoints for listing, creating, and deleting todos
Persist todos in embedded SQLite storage across restarts
Provide health check and structured JSON error responses
Log each request with method, path, status, and duration
Handle concurrent requests safely with graceful shutdown
components.architectureContext: Sole backend service exposed over HTTP/JSON on port 9090; clients call it directly. It owns its embedded SQLite database file and has no upstream/downstream services.
keyConsiderations: Use modernc.org/sqlite (pure Go) to avoid CGo in Docker builds
Default TODO_DB_PATH to /data/todos.db and ensure directory exists in image
Serialize DB access or use proper connection settings to avoid SQLite write contention
Consistent JSON error envelope; never leak internal error details on 500
Graceful shutdown on SIGTERM; response latency under 500ms
components.apiContract:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Todo API
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status: {type: string}
  /todos:
    get:
      summary: List todos
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Todo'}
    post:
      summary: Create todo
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/TodoCreate'}
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Todo'}
        '400':
          description: Bad Request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'}
  /todos/{id}:
    delete:
      summary: Delete todo
      parameters:
        - in: path
          name: id
          required: true
          schema: {type: string}
      responses:
        '204': {description: No Content}
        '404':
          description: Not Found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'}
components:
  schemas:
    Todo:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: {type: string}
        title: {type: string}
        description: {type: string}
        completed: {type: boolean}
        createdAt: {type: string, format: date-time}
    TodoCreate:
      type: object
      required: [title]
      properties:
        title: {type: string}
        description: {type: string}
    Error:
      type: object
      properties:
        error: {type: string}
